lib_path.description: Path to the LDraw parts library. Can also be set via the LEOCAD_LIB environment variable.

stud_style.description: Stud style ID: 0=Plain, 1=Thin Lines Logo, 2=Outline Logo, 3=Sharp Top Logo, 4=Rounded Top Logo, 5=Flattened Logo, 6=High Contrast, 7=High Contrast with Logo.

shading_mode.description: Shading mode for rendering: wireframe, flat, default, or full.

fov.description: Vertical field of view in degrees used for rendering images.

near_clip.description: Near clipping plane distance for rendering (must be >= 1).

far_clip.description: Far clipping plane distance for rendering (must be > near_clip).

fade_steps_color.description: Color to use for rendering parts from prior steps when faded (#AARRGGBB).

highlight_color.description: Color to use to highlight parts in the steps they appear (#AARRGGBB).

light_dark_value.description: Value to indicate a light or dark color for shading/lighting calculations.

black_edge_color.description: High contrast edge color for black parts (#AARRGGBB).

dark_edge_color.description: High contrast edge color for dark color parts (#AARRGGBB).
